evidence: Modifies .github/workflows/guix.yml, .github/install-guix.sh, and contrib/guix scripts to automate Guix builds in CI, directly matching the area definition.
rationale: Automating Guix builds in CI prevents build breakages, missing imports, and codesign manifest errors from remaining hidden until late in the release cycle. Running matrix builds for Darwin, Linux, and Windows provides durable protection for release integrity and reduces maintainer friction during releases.
